Implement TopModule using the tools. write_design compiles your design on its own and returns the compiler output. You can also write your own self-checking testbench (write_testbench) and run it (run_simulation). Hidden tests will grade the design; you cannot see them, so verify the behaviour yourself. Derive expected values independently from the specification (e.g. a behavioural model or hand-computed vectors), not by copying your design's logic, and cover reset, edge cases and multi-cycle sequences for clocked designs.
You may call write_design at most 5 times. When you are confident the design is correct, call submit.
